description: Surface the shell exposes to the Panel webview. `core:window:allow-start-dragging` is required for the macOS overlay-titlebar drag strip. The custom Tauri commands the shell exposes are the connection-target config toggles (`get_connection_target` / `set_connection_target` / `clear_connection_target`), the variant flag `is_lite_shell` (registered by both variants), and — panel-only builds only — the first-run connect surface (`discover_servers` mDNS browse / `connect_to` probe-guarded target switch). All are I/O config, not business or UI logic (R2/R4 boundary, spec §5.2 explicit exception). Every panel-facing operation still routes through the gateway's `fs.*` / `projects.*` JSON-RPC, which works identically for desktop, localhost web, and remote Tailnet web (R6 — one core, many channels).
